name: Indosaurus
isnote: PBDB places it in Majungasaurini; abelisaurid placement within the family is not stable for this poorly known Indian genus.
sum: Maastrichtian carnivorous theropod from India whose holotype was found between 1917 and 1919 and is now lost.
material: Not given in the sources used.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Huene 1933
